source_title: GHMC Citizen Charter — Road & Infrastructure Maintenance
content: Potholes and road surface defects on municipal roads are maintained by the GHMC Engineering Wing (Roads). The standard response timeframe under the municipal citizen charter is 48 hours for arterial and sub-arterial roads.

Overflowing dumper bins, illegal solid waste dumping on public roads, and street sweeping fall under the jurisdiction of the GHMC Health & Sanitation Wing. Target clearance response timeframe is 24 hours.

source_title: HMWSSB Water Supply & Sewerage Citizen Charter
source_publisher: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
content: Sewerage overflows, open/damaged sewerage manhole covers, and drinking water pipeline bursts are administered by HMWSSB. Standard response timeframe for sewer clearing and line containment is 24 hours.

source_title: TGSPDCL Consumer Charter & Electrical Safety Guidelines
source_publisher: Telangana State Southern Power Distribution Co. Ltd. (TGSPDCL)
content: Sagging live electrical conductors, tilted distribution poles, sparking transformers, and open junction boxes fall under the TGSPDCL Operation Circle. Safety hazard containment response target is within 12 hours.

source_title: HYDRAA Urban Flooding & Waterbody Protection Framework
content: Severe flash urban waterlogging, primary stormwater drain (NALA) obstructions, and lake buffer zone encroachments are coordinated by the HYDRAA Disaster Response Team in conjunction with GHMC DRF.

source_title: Hyderabad Traffic Police Traffic Engineering Redressal
content: Non-functioning traffic signals, timer failures, and major physical road obstructions impacting arterial junctions fall under the Hyderabad Traffic Police Engineering Wing.
